name: JustinGPT
summary: This chatbot: a ChatGPT-style living resume that answers questions about my career.
problem: A static resume can't answer follow-up questions or show how I actually think.
architecture: Two-step pipeline: a structured-JSON classifier routes each question, then a grounded answer prompt streams the reply
Layered prompt-injection defenses: preflight heuristics, nonce-tagged delimiters, a streaming canary scanner, and least-context data selection
Versioned prompts tuned with an eval suite of deterministic graders; v2 took the suite from 52% to 98%
Test-driven core: every guard, prompt contract, and the API route are covered by unit tests with mocked models
outcome: Live as my interactive resume; eval history and design notes are in the repo.
